title: Understanding Imbalanced Semantic Segmentation Through Neural Collapse (CeCo)
mechanism: Regularize class feature centers toward a simplex equiangular tight frame, which imbalance and context otherwise break, to improve minor-class discrimination.
adaptation: Class centers from a >=32-dim projection of the full-res decoder features (17 present classes); same plumbing as region rebalance. Could separate crack vs inactive vs scuff.
min_experiment: Arm: CeCo regularizer on best loss/sampling arm, 3 seeds; baseline that arm; metric mIoU_rob and E1 crack recall; kill if no gain >= 0.01.
evidence: R: improvements on 2D and 3D seg benchmarks; ScanNet200 test 1st place, +6.8 mIoU.
